FILTER(WHERE prev_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_previous, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cur_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_current, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw WHERE client_key IS NULL AND ((tx_day >= records.question: Departemen mana yang selisih total pendapatannya (dalam rupiah) paling besar naik dari 2024 ke 2025, dan berapa selisihnya?
records.sql: WITH pendapatan_tahunan AS (SELECT departemen, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(tanggal_layanan) = 2024 THEN pendapatan_rp ELSE 0 END) AS pendapatan_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(tanggal_layanan) = 2025 THEN pendapatan_rp ELSE 0 END) AS pendapatan_2025 FROM dataset WHERE YEAR(tanggal_layanan) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY departemen) SELECT departemen, pendapatan_2025 - pendapatan_2024 AS selisih_pendapatan_rp FROM pendapatan_tahunan WHERE pendapatan_2025 > pendapatan_2024 ORDER BY selisih_pendapatan_rp DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Pendapatan yang kosong tidak menambah total karena SUM mengabaikan nilai NULL; jika seluruh nilai dalam suatu kelompok kosong, kontribusinya diperlakukan sebagai nol.

records.question: For each year, what is the total revenue divided by the number of unique clients in that year?
records.sql: SELECT YEAR(tanggal_layanan) AS year, SUM(pendapatan_rp) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id_klien), 0) AS revenue_per_unique_client FROM dataset WHERE MONTH(tanggal_layanan) <= 10 GROUP BY YEAR(tanggal_layanan) ORDER BY year
assumptions: Uses January through October for each year so the periods are comparable with 2026, whose available data ends in October.
Unique clients are counted as distinct non-null id_klien values. Revenue sums non-null pendapatan_rp values.
records.answer: Revenue per unique client was highest in 2026 and lowest in 2025.

records.question: Departemen mana yang paling banyak memiliki transaksi Dibatalkan, dan berapa persen dari seluruh transaksi departemen itu yang dibatalkan (0–100)?

assumptions: Setiap baris dianggap satu transaksi; persentase dihitung sebagai transaksi Dibatalkan dibagi seluruh transaksi pada departemen yang sama, dikali 100.
